Notes: HGSS_DECAPPED renders lowercase names while the rest of the game is still ALL-CAPS until the Decapitalized branch is merged (plan Phase 1A)

Change: Enable follower Pokemon

Notes: I_EXP_SHARE_ITEM still GEN_5 - plan Phase 0E calls for GEN_6 (party-wide key item)

Notes: Normal ROM build succeeded, verified in emulator. Shows in-game time, not wall-clock. Weekday omitted (pokeemerald day-of-week is a counter from 0=Saturday, not a real date)
